payload.kickoff_note: Sun Jul 5 4:00pm EDT at MetLife Stadium (FIFA: New York New Jersey Stadium), East Rutherford NJ; 4-source cross-check (ESPN gameId 760504, NBC, World Soccer Talk, Sky Sports UK 9pm BST = 20:00 UTC); Goal.com's 'July 6 / 16:00 EST' listing discarded as timezone artifact; only match scheduled Jul 5... note Match 92 MEX-ENG also listed Jul 5 by protocol table - Sky's 'only match' claim not load-bearing

adjustment_reasons: -10: Paqueta ruled OUT (CBF imaging statement Jun 30, back-of-left-thigh muscle tear, ~2-3 weeks). Starter #8 but NOT the xG carrier - Brazil's attack is distributed (Vinicius 2.1 of ~9.0 team xG; Guimaraes led shots vs Japan) and replacements are genuine (Endrick took the slot at HT vs Japan; Neymar candidate; Martinelli scored the R32 winner). Magnitude conservative per pilot doctrine (Balogun -25 was 46%-of-xG; Paqueta is well below that)

-5: Raphinha doubt at half weight - sources conflict (Goal Jul 1: back in individual training, late call, may be preserved for QF; FotMob availability list: expected return mid-July; a second Goal fetch said 'available'). Baseline status quo: Brazil already played and won its last two matches without him

+10: logistics bundle, single conservative entry not stacked items - Brazil's tournament base camp is Morristown NJ ~34km from the venue (zero relocation; effectively a home-base match) vs Norway's base at UNC Greensboro ~725km (flight + hotel move); Brazil 6 rest days vs Norway 5; 4pm EDT open-air kickoff, NWS high 89F - FIFA formally warned the Norway camp about training in the heat and Norway's own physiologist flagged heat/ET concern, Brazil's heat adaptation self-evidently better; expected pro-Brazil crowd at 82k MetLife (large NY-area Brazilian community; reasoned assumption, not ticket data)
0: Casemiro (cramp/minor adductor vs Japan, self-reported fine, trending available) - no deduction; invalidation entry covers late ruling-out
0: no suspensions either side (yellows wiped after groups); Casemiro+Danilo (BRA) and Nusa (NOR) each one booking from a QF ban - symmetric-ish care incentive, no adjustment
inputs.pk_note: Alisson elite + Brazil 3-of-5 WC shootout record (last: lost 2022 vs CRO) vs Nyland 35 in strong form (4 saves + injury-time wonder-save vs CIV) + Norway has never contested a WC shootout in its history; evidence thin both ways - default kept (M94 pattern)

basis: single mechanism, single direction: rotation-distorted Elo input. Norway's 1934 carries a ~25-30pt hit from the 1-4 France loss played by a deliberate B-team - Solbakken rested 10 first-teamers INCLUDING Haaland and Odegaard (NRK headline, primary source) after medical tests showed 5-6 players 'very affected' post-Senegal; that B-team still won the RealGM xG 1.70-1.50 while France started Dembele (hat-trick). Elo has no lineup knowledge and scored it as a full-strength 3-goal loss (K=60, G~1.75, We~0.28 -> ~-27). Credited back at half weight per conservative-magnitude doctrine: +10 to Norway -> d_J = +82

doctrine tension declared honestly: this sits in the legal 'rotation signal' input class and is mechanically computed from K/G/We (not fitted to any price), but it is PUBLIC information the market almost certainly also prices - so it fails the strict 'market-may-not-have-it' test even though it passes the 'not derived from market' test. Logged for B1 to adjudicate; if J again merely tracks the market here, that is one more data point for the market-simulator failure mode

no style/lambda/pk edits (clean-J, SUI-ALG pattern): the TFA+NRK convergent read (Brazil vulnerable in transition x Norway's transition-attack identity = the credible upset path) and the counter-reads (Haaland finishing +2.5 over xG = mean-reversion risk; Nyland running hot; Brazil's far deeper bench in 89F heat/ET; Brazil process +1.22 xG-diff/m vs Norway +0.76) were examined and NETTED TO ZERO - they pull opposite directions and none is market-missing; refusing to stack them avoids the SUI-ALG double-count and the ESP-AUT talk-both-sides trap

quasi-independent model cluster unavailable for this match: Opta match-level number sits behind a JS widget (Chrome session unavailable) - recorded as not-obtained rather than guessed; only stale tournament-level Opta (Jun 1: BRA title 6.6%/SF 22.1%, NOR title 3.5%/'last four 23.9%'; Jun 28 pre-R32: BRA 6.5%) reached the pack. NRK expert's subjective '60-40 Brazil' (non-market pundit number) noted as loosely corroborating J's 61.5% qualify, weighted near zero

rationale: Elo raw +97 (BRA 2031 #5 vs NOR 1934 #10): Brazil moderate favorite over a genuine top-10 side, closest-rated R16 pairing locked so far besides M94
M net adjustment -5 (injuries -15, logistics +10) -> d_eff +92: 46.7/29.2/24.1, qualify 62.8%; J's single rotation-artifact credit -> d_J +82: 45.3/29.6/25.1, qualify 61.5%

process xG corroborates the ordering without changing it: Brazil +1.22/m but vs a weak slate and LOST the xG to its one quality opponent (Morocco 1.23-1.53); Norway +0.76/m and out-created all four opponents including rotated-self vs France; both R32s were 90-minute wins (no ET legs), 6 vs 5 rest days

goals model lambdas 1.42/0.99 (total ~2.42); weather is the biggest scenario risk: NWS 89F, 50% chance of showers with thunderstorms possible after 2pm - a delay/interruption adds variance, direction unclear, no adjustment
H2H narrative (Norway unbeaten vs Brazil P4 W2 D2, incl. WC1998 2-1) is 20+ years stale - zero adjustment, but flagged as retail-narrative fuel for Phase 2 reading
invalidation: Casemiro ruled out or absent from announced XI -> amend toward Norway
Raphinha in the announced starting XI -> amend toward Brazil (restore the -5 half-weight)
Haaland, Odegaard, or Nyland missing from announced XI -> amend toward Brazil
Alisson missing from announced XI -> amend toward Norway (Ederson's form was poor pre-tournament)
Ryerson passed fit and starts at RB -> no amend (public 50/50 recovery race, small magnitude, deputy Pedersen has started every match)
Neymar vs Endrick as the Paqueta replacement -> no amend (selection variance, direction unclear: Neymar upside vs 14 total minutes of match fitness)
thunderstorm delay/interruption -> no probability amend (variance note only)
referee appointment published -> no amend unless a documented extreme-card-rate profile

payload.contamination_notes: Evidence gathered by 9 collector subagents under an explicit no-odds firewall (6 original: Brazil-news, Norway-news, logistics succeeded; xG, models, previews died mid-run to an account spend limit with outputs unrecovered and never read by the analyst; 3 tightened replacements succeeded). Analyst read only structured agent returns plus two direct analyst fetches of non-odds pages (eloratings.net TSVs; theanalyst.com article). Declared incidental exposures: (1) previews agent's search-engine summary displayed explicit market lines (a Brazil moneyline, a W/D/W percentage triplet, a Norway double-chance price) - the agent transcribed no figures; what reached the analyst is the agent's qualitative disclosure that 'the lines showed Brazil as a modest favorite', a direction M and J had already produced independently - declared as qualitative directional market exposure pre-lock; (2) models agent's search snippet relayed moneyline/advance figures from sportsbettingdime - discarded by the agent, no numbers reached the pack or analyst; (3) odds-site URLs surfaced across searches and were never opened (espn.com/soccer/odds gameId 760504, rotowire odds slug, dknetwork, betmgm, freetips, yahoo betting-picks, ladbrokes preview, sportsbettingdime, ghanasoccernet correct-score, skysports group-guide with 'odds' in slug, goal.com golden-boot-odds) - none of the surfaced slugs encodes a market direction for this match; (4) NRK expert's '60-40' is a pundit's subjective probability on a non-bookmaker state broadcaster - treated as legal secondhand analysis, weighted near zero; (5) Opta tournament-level numbers used are pre-R32-stale and Opta's methodology admits odds input - down-weighted and declared; the post-R32 match-level Opta number was NOT read (JS widget, no browser session). No price for this match was retrieved, read, or snapshotted before lock. Unresolved factual conflicts flagged in sources: Raphinha availability (3-way), Brazil-Japan xG provider spread, 1997/1988 H2H training-knowledge items, RealGM differential-ranking line discarded.
